{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check if QA orders exist (revenue 999999.99)
qa_count = (sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99).sum()
print("QA orders found:", qa_count)

# Drop QA orders if any
if qa_count > 0:
    sales = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]
    print(f"Dropped {qa_count} QA orders.")
else:
    print("No QA orders found.")

# Drop refunded orders — they are not real revenue
sales = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']
print(f"Remaining rows after filtering completed orders: {len(sales)}")"}
